reads.pagination: none — single GET on mount via messagingApi.getState(), no threads list consumed by this screen (MessagingState.threads is fetched but never read/rendered here)
none — read synchronously from the singleton mock session store (currentSession), not fetched. creator is nullable on Session; component falls back to tier ?? "basic" if creator is null.
none — static import PLANS[tier] from src/types/subscription.ts, not an API call

uiStatesHandled.entersWhen: !locked && enabled — enabled is local useState(true) default, locked = penalty is "disabled7"/"disabled30"; togglable by clicking the switch, which only flips local state (no API call)
!locked && !enabled — user clicks the accept-toggle button to turn it off

uiStatesHandled.reachable: yes as a client-side override (see next state's note) but never as the outcome of a real fetch — mock messagingApi.getState() always resolves penalty:"warned" (hardcoded literal in mocks/messaging.ts), so penalty never legitimately becomes "none" from data; it is only reachable by clicking the unguarded "Good" preview pill at the top of the screen, which calls setPenalty("none") directly with no gate, no SEAM tag, and no dev-only marker (unlike the tagged switches in mocks/session.ts / STUB-1, STUB-2).

uiStatesHandled.entersWhen: penalty === "none" || penalty === "warned" renders the reply-record card; "none" specifically shows the success pill
uiStatesHandled.reachable: same caveat as above — reachable only via the untagged pill selector, not via fetched mock data

uiStatesHandled.entersWhen: penalty === "warned" — shows warning banner, standing gauge, "Raise the price"/"Switch off" buttons (both local-state-only, no API call), and the reply-record warning pill
uiStatesHandled.reachable: yes — this is the literal value mocks/messaging.ts's currentMessaging.penalty is hardcoded to, so it is what actually renders after the real fetch resolves; also directly selectable via the "Warning" pill

uiStatesHandled.entersWhen: penalty === "disabled7" — toggle rendered inert/greyed, price input hidden, danger banner, countdown card, Save button disabled
uiStatesHandled.reachable: no from real/fetched data — mock getState() never returns this value; reachable only by clicking the untagged "Off 7d" preview pill, which is a client-side-only override with no backend authority behind it

uiStatesHandled.entersWhen: penalty === "disabled30" — same layout as disabled7 with 30-day copy/progress
uiStatesHandled.reachable: no from real/fetched data, same reasoning as disabled7 — reachable only via the untagged "Off 30d" preview pill

uiStatesHandled.entersWhen: N/A — not coded. While messagingApi.getState() promise is pending, the component simply shows its default useState values (price=300, penalty="none", rate=4, enabled=true); there is no spinner/skeleton and no isLoading flag anywhere in the file.
uiStatesHandled.reachable: no — no such state exists in the code to be reached

uiStatesHandled.entersWhen: N/A — not coded. messagingApi.getState().then(...) has no .catch; mockRequest never rejects in the mock, and the component has no error UI or error state variable.
uiStatesHandled.reachable: no — no such state exists in the code to be reached

uiStatesHandled.entersWhen: N/A — the Save button (<Button full size="lg" disabled={locked}>Save</Button>) has no onClick handler at all. Clicking it (when not locked) does nothing; none of price/penalty/enabled ever gets persisted anywhere, and messagingApi has no update/save method for settings (only getState, getStats, getPenalty, getThreads, getThread, replyToThread).
uiStatesHandled.reachable: no — there is no code path that performs a save

Matches the code's !locked && enabled && penalty==="none" combination.
